paragraphs: Seder HaDorot cites this from the beginning of Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 34: he reported in the name of Rabbi Meir. Our reading is R' Abba bar Yirmeyah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ס״הד is read contextually as Seder HaDorot. רפ״לד gives beginning of chapter 34. The named Midrash Rabbah -- TE text at 34:1 has Abba bar Yirmeyah in full Rabbi Meir’s name; that exact phrase supports the Meir expansion.

The named text does not give a full Rabbi title before Abba; its later fuller parentage says Abba bar Rabbi Yirmeyah. That father-title is not transferred to Abba. Hyman’s separate Abba Yirmeyah and our-reading R' Abba bar Yirmeyah remain distinct. אמר has the heading figure as understood subject, not a lost line-break subject or omitted quoted content.
